data.body:
Measured 2026-10-19 (coordinator): a roborev review is a kilo AGENT LOOP of 5-21 model calls (median ~11), each re-sending ~80k input tokens with cache read 0 (0.4-1.8M input tokens per job), ~1 min per call on the LAN DeepSeek host, so 5-24 min per job (median 4). Wasted steps: the agent tries pytest (denied), globs /nix/store for site-packages, runs bash probes. Queue wait, not run time, caused the timeouts: job 3069 waited 67 min (outage), 4 workers active although config says max_workers=6 (daemon up 474h, config not re-read), duplicate jobs for one sha (3067/3068, 3071/3072), event-log and merge commits queued too. Agents' own wait caps (25 min monitors, 30 min job_timeout) then record standards unavailable. Candidate levers: review_guidelines or kilo permission rules that forbid bash/glob outside the repo and test runs (forces a near one-shot review); exclude_patterns for .ddflow/events/**, pins and generated files; dedupe by sha at enqueue; restart the daemon with max_workers 6 (needs operator OK, kills running jobs); LAN host prefix caching (--enable-prefix-caching) so repeated prompt prefixes are cached; second kilo provider on the external proxy for spill; ddflow waits queue-aware (position, ETA) and re-run standards later instead of recording unavailable; sentinel standards re-run task after drain. Measure before and after (steps, input tokens, minutes per job).

RESULT 2026-10-19 (coordinator), same three commits (9b13c04d6, f1710c889, 10808fe35): before (Flash host, old prompt) 8/23/16 model calls, 9.0/14.5/8.9 min, 0.6-2.0M input tokens; after (Pro host, BUDGET guideline, kilo permissions tightened, 8 workers) 5/7/8 calls, 1.0/1.5/2.0 min, 0.35-0.63M tokens. Biggest cause: .roborev.toml in the repo pins model+backup and overrides [REDACTED:path], and the Flash host carries ~140 concurrent requests from other users while the Pro host idles. Config is machine-local (git-ignored); ddflow-side items (queue-aware wait, sha de-dup, re-run path) are with fleet-roborev-speed. Prefix caching was already on (85-92% hit rate).

data.how: Check the LAN vLLM load first (curl host:8000/metrics, vllm:num_requests_running): a shared Flash host at ~140 concurrent requests made every kilo step ~30 s while Pro idled. 'roborev pause' survives a daemon restart; resume with 'roborev unpause'.
data.rule: After changing roborev model/agent, enqueue a fresh review and read its model field in 'roborev list --json'; queued jobs keep the model and prompt they were enqueued with.
